title: Masterclass on LinkedIn Sales Outreach
cardDescription: Zero Point Five’s LinkedIn Sales Outreach Masterclass with Tejas Jhaveri. Learn how to book 200+ meetings a month and scale your GTM.
description:
A hands-on session for founders who need meetings on the calendar, not theory. It works for domestic and international outreach.

Who this is for: founders and B2B businesses (entrepreneurs and CXOs who want a steady flow of conversations), marketing teams building a LinkedIn and cold email outreach engine, and anyone learning outreach, including students, employees and business owners curious about cold outreach.
metaTitle: LinkedIn Sales Outreach Masterclass for Founders
metaDescription: Live online masterclass on 28 Nov 2026, 12 to 1 pm IST. Learn LinkedIn profile setup, messaging and funnels that book meetings. Save your seat.
